title: Workflows in Depth: Expressions, Variables, Branches and Loops | Orchard Core
description:
A workflow that only runs one activity after another does little. Useful workflows compute values, remember them, choose a path, and repeat steps.

The Workflows module does this with expressions in three syntaxes (Literal, Liquid and JavaScript), typed variables, outcomes and transitions, and the For Each, For Loop and While Loop activities. The Scripting module runs the JavaScript.

In this video:
• Expressions: Literal, Liquid and JavaScript
• Variables: typed values that every activity can read
• Branches: outcomes and transitions
• Loops: For Each, For Loop and While Loop
• Extending expressions: syntaxes, activities and script functions
